annotator_notes:
S2 of C02-047. Reviewer-confirmed 2026-09-20. OUTSIDE §9.1's in-force denominator: redacted_value is WITHHELD_VALUE and mutual_obligation is REPRESENTATIONAL, both excluding kinds (§8.10).

TEMPORAL null -- §15.2's VAGUE rule and §8.1's REDACTION rule agreeing, on two INDEPENDENT grounds, and the fallback was VERIFIED BY EXECUTION rather than assumed. The timing reads 'promptly (but no later than [***] of receipt of such information)'. (1) 'promptly' is a bare vague qualifier -> §15.2, temporal null, phrase recorded in the non-scored vague_temporal_phrase. (2) The parenthetical that WOULD quantify it is redacted -> §8.1, field null, field named in missing_fields, redacted_phrase recorded, known_gaps gains redacted_value.

§15.5's 'VAGUE QUALIFIER + EXPLICIT TRIGGER' BRANCH DOES NOT APPLY, and this was checked rather than waved off -- it is the branch that would otherwise force RELATIVE_TO_TRIGGER. That branch needs the vague word to be IMMEDIATELY FOLLOWED by a named triggering event ('Promptly after the receipt of notice'). Here 'of receipt of such information' sits INSIDE the redacted parenthetical as the measuring-point of a withheld DURATION, not as a trigger the span offers to the duty. Confirmed against the production classifier: 'no later than [***] of receipt of such information' -> None, and even a plausible UNREDACTED 'no later than 5 days of receipt of such information' -> None, while 'by 5 days of receipt of such information' -> BY "...". So only a literal 'by' classifies; the form is unreachable on this text whether or not the value is withheld.

UNDERSPECIFIED true, and NOT on account of the redaction -- §8.1's v0.28 struck clause forbids that, and §3.9's trigger list is closed. It is true on trigger 1 alone: 'Each Party' is a DISTRIBUTIVE reference and 'the other' a RELATIONAL one, neither of which resolve_party() can match (§3.9 trigger 1, §3.5.1 branch 2). missing_fields carries 'temporal' per §8.1's own instruction, and §5 excludes missing_fields from the predicate.

§8.4.2 FIRES HERE WHERE IT FAILED ON BOTH SIBLINGS -- the contrast is the instructive part of this segment. (a) MUST is duty-bearing; (b) 'Each Party' is the distributive form, read from the obligor slot; (c) the obligee IS that same counterparty -- 'the other' is a reciprocal reference. C14-01's shape exactly. C02-05 and C02-07 each fail at (c) on an ABSENT obligee.

OBLIGEE 'the other' verbatim per §3.5's as-it-appears rule -- not normalised to 'the other Party'. §3.5.1 branch 2 keeps a relational reference verbatim and ABSENT would be factually false: a subject IS stated.

CONDITIONS EMPTY. 'of any information which might affect the marketability, safety, or effectiveness ... and/or which might result in the Recall or seizure' is the OBJECT and its restrictive relative clauses -- §3.8.2's removal test makes it object scope, not a circumstance gating the duty. '(to be confirmed in writing)' is a manner requirement on the notification, not a gate.

OBJECT_CLASS head-only member 'information' present (§3.6 v0.58). §3.6.2 checked against the whole action_accept_set (['NOTIFY','REPORT','DISCLOSE']): no member restates any of the three -- note 'notice'/'notification' was deliberately NOT authored for that reason, unlike C22-01 where the document's own word for the object IS 'notice' and carve-out 1 applies.
segment_text: (a) Records and Notice. In addition to the requirements of Section 6.2, Antares and AMAG shall each maintain such records in compliance with Applicable Laws as is reasonably necessary to permit a Recall of any Products, sample Products and Trainers delivered to AMAG, AMAG's designee or customers of AMAG. Each Party shall promptly (but no later than [***] of receipt of such information) notify the other by telephone (to be confirmed in writing) of any information which might affect the marketability, safety, or effectiveness of the Products, sample Products or Trainers and/or which might result in the Recall or seizure of the Products, sample Products, or Trainers. Upon receiving any such notice or upon any such discovery, each Party shall cease and desist from further shipments of such Products, sample Products or Trainers in its possession or control until a decision by AMAG has been made whether a Recall or some other corrective action is necessary.
